messages:
Alex C: FYI starterkit CI failing on structured-output + function call when auth retry happens. Payload parse error referencing trailing newline.
Priya K: I repro'd locally. TS retry wrapper is re-stringifying an already-serialized json-mode body on 401->retry path. That produces a quoted string with escaped newline -> schema validator fails.
Samir P: Py signs bytes(json + '\n') while TS signs json without newline. On retry we sign a different byte sequence.
Maria S: So we need parity two places: (1) don't double-serialize in retry; (2) canonicalize signing over the exact bytes sent (including json-mode newline delimiter).
Priya K: Proposed patch: in retry.ts use: const payload = typeof opts.body === 'string' || Buffer.isBuffer(opts.body) ? opts.body : JSON.stringify(opts.body); sign(Buffer.from(payload)); send payload as-is. Add assert that content-type includes application/json.
Samir P: I'll add unit tests that compare signature output against the Py helper for identical inputs (including newline). Also add a test that simulates a 401 then 200 to exercise retry path.
Alex C: Maria, can you add a small e2e in sample-app that stubs auth to return 401 once and then 200 and verifies received raw bytes equal expected (Buffer comparison) and schema validates?
Maria S: Yep, will add sample-app/tests/auth-retry-parity.test.ts with proxy that checks Buffer.from(req.body) equals Buffer.from(expected).
ci-bot: PR #4871 opened by priya-k: "ts: avoid double-serialize in retry + sign canonical payload"  https://ci.redwood/p/4871
Priya K: Added note to SDK migration docs: "If using json-mode helper, do not re-serialize body in middleware/retry logic; preserve bytes to maintain signing and schema parity with other SDKs."
Alex C: Great. Once PR CI green, merge and run sample-app CI. Thanks all. :rocket:
